mx_jazz_arm_push.line: good for: a theatrical jazz loop, right arm sweeps overhead (0-0.3 s, again 1.0-1.4 s) into a deep side lean with the head lolling sideways 0.5-0.9 s, then the arm pushes out low 1.9-2.1 s; weak at: anything quiet, the head-loll lean reads drunk in a close-up; needs: relaxed grip (hands are flat boards, curl 14 deg and never move)
mx_jazz_arm_push.watched: strip 0-4.7 s, hands burst 0-1 s, own full-body burst 0.4-1.5 s (knee flag: no visible flip, back leg only straightens)

mx_jazz_around_world.line: good for: a clean jazz loop, both arms circle overhead and out with a knee lift (passe) at 0.1-0.3 s and 1.2-1.4 s, open and in place, reads well wide and medium; weak at: close-ups at 0.43-0.5 s and 2.1 s when a forearm crosses in front of the face; needs: relaxed grip (flat dead hands, curl 15 deg throughout)
mx_jazz_around_world.watched: strip 0-4.6 s, hands burst 0-1 s, own full-body burst 1.0-2.0 s (knee flag: knee lifts read normal)

needs: mask: lower if arms must come in
mx_jazz_square.line: good for: the jazz square footwork (cross, back, side, front) on a 2 s loop, steps travel about 0.5 m and come back; weak at: the arms, held out at shoulder height like airplane wings almost the whole loop, mannequin-like in a medium shot; needs: relaxed grip, or take only the legs (mask lower) under another upper body

mx_locking.line: good for: a long funk locking routine with real character: low wide lunge crouches 5.4-7.0 s, stand-up locks with the arm thrown overhead 8.6-8.9 s and swept across 9.0-9.4 s, side shuffles 11.0-11.8 s, a low kick-lunge 12.0-12.6 s; weak at: the low lunges (lean 63 deg) in a tight frame, head drops out; needs: nothing (pick a segment, it is 17 s)
mx_locking.watched: strip 4.6-12.6 s (busiest 8 s), hands burst near 11.8 s, own bursts preview 0.8-2.9 s full body and 3.4-5.0 s medium

mx_maraschino.line: good for: a goofy hunched groove with claw hands (curl 100-120 deg), shoulders up, that turns a full circle; good as comic or creepy character dance; weak at: 1.2-2.4 s his back is to the front camera, and the claw hands rule out any normal gesture; needs: nothing
mx_maraschino.watched: strip 0-3.3 s, hands burst around 3.0 s

needs: start at 5.5 s for the side-on kicks
mark the travel: drifts up to 2 m
mx_northern_soul.line: good for: legs-only northern soul footwork, flick kicks and swivels with the arms hanging loose, side-on kicks 5.5-6.5 s; weak at: anything for the upper body (arms just hang), he turns his back to the front 1.7-3.7 s and roams up to 2 m from the mark; legs lock very straight in side view (knee hyperextension flag, not a visible flip); needs: a wide frame and the travel planned
mx_northern_soul.watched: strip 0.13-8.1 s, hands burst, own full-body bursts preview 0-1.6 s and 5.4-7.0 s

mx_pose_hand_head.line: good for: a held pose, right hand flat at the brow shading the eyes (looking far off, or a loose salute), weight easy; weak at: nothing for a still; needs: nothing (one frame, hold it with keys or a layer)
mx_pose_hand_head.watched: preview 0-0.5 s, still at 0.2 s both cameras

mx_pose_hand_hip.line: good for: a casual one-hand-on-hip stand, weight on one leg; weak at: the hip hand floats palm-up just off the waist in the medium shot, it does not rest on the hip; needs: nothing for wide, a reach to the hip for a medium
mx_pose_hand_hip.watched: preview 0-0.5 s, still at 0.2 s both cameras

mx_pose_hip_arm_up.line: good for: a pin-up pose, one hand behind the head, the other on the hip; weak at: the hip hand is fanned stiff with fingers spread (fannedFrac 1) right in the medium shot; needs: relaxed grip on the hip hand
mx_pose_hip_arm_up.watched: preview 0-0.5 s, still at 0.2 s both cameras

mx_pose_hips_look_back.line: good for: hands on the lower back, leaning back (21 deg) as if stretching a sore back or taking a tired breath; weak at: look-back, despite the name the head faces front (yaw 0); needs: nothing
mx_pose_hips_look_back.watched: preview 0-0.5 s, still at 0.2 s both cameras, own full-body burst

needs: drop 0.05 m to stand, or play it as a mid-hop
mx_pose_leg_hip_arm.line: good for: a pin-up kick pose, hand on head, hand on hip, legs crossed with one heel kicked up; weak at: standing, both feet are off the lawn (lowest foot 0.17 m, about 5 cm of air) so it reads as a hop frozen in air; needs: lowering 5 cm or a hop around it

mx_pose_legs_crossed_hip.line: good for: a relaxed stand with legs crossed at the ankle and one fist on the hip, the other arm loose; weak at: nothing for a still; needs: nothing
mx_pose_legs_crossed_hip.watched: preview 0-0.5 s, still at 0.2 s both cameras

mx_rib_pops.line: good for: a vogue-like pop loop, palms out framing the face and chest, chest isolations; weak at: the hands are spread stiff palms-out the whole loop (mannequin), and a forearm hangs in front of the face 0.4-0.9 s; needs: relaxed grip unless the spread palms are the style

mx_rumba.line: good for: rumba box steps with the arms held in a partner frame at chest height; good with a partner in the hold; weak at: solo, the empty frame arms with drooping flat hands read stiff and zombie-like; needs: a partner, or mask lower under other arms

needs: mask: lower if arms must stay in
mx_salsa_f.line: good for: salsa basic on the balls of the feet with feminine styling, one arm held wide at shoulder height and the other sweeping up past the face (0.6-1.0 s, 3.4-3.7 s); weak at: the wide arm and stiff spread fingers at 0.2-0.4 s in a medium shot; needs: legs only (mask lower) for a plain step

mx_salsa_side.line: good for: a Latin side step with a knee lift, one hand resting on the belly and the other swinging out to the side (0-0.4 s, 2.0-2.3 s), loose and in place; weak at: the hand on the stomach can read as a stomach ache in a close-up, and both hands flash open spread at 1.4-1.6 s; needs: nothing

mx_salsa_up_back.line: good for: a quiet salsa forward-and-back basic, hands low at the waist, a background dancer; weak at: anything with energy, and the hands are flat and splayed at waist height the whole loop (left fanned 28% of frames); needs: relaxed grip
